1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder; a solvent; and __a substrate surface to which the composition is applied, wherein the thermally conductive binder comprises a material selected from the group consisting of thermally conductive epoxy and solder paste__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and the thermally conductive binder is a material distinct from those disclosed in You et al. Patent No. 5,814,392 as a glue__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __and the binder remains on the surface after solvent removal__.
